title: Work in the Coming Decades
text:
Many experts believe that the job market will change dramatically over the next twenty years. Routine tasks in offices and factories are increasingly being done by machines. As a result, workers will need to develop skills that technology cannot easily replace, such as creativity, communication and critical thinking. Some people see this as a threat, while others view it as an opportunity.

Education is adapting to these changes. Many universities now offer short courses that teach practical digital skills to adults who want to switch careers. Employers, too, are investing in retraining programmes for their staff. Experts often advise young people to stay flexible, because the job they train for today may look very different when they finally enter the workforce.

questions.text: According to the first paragraph, what is happening to routine tasks in offices and factories?
options: They are being increasingly done by machines.
They are being moved to other countries.
They are being abolished by governments.
They are being done only by young people.

questions.text: According to the second paragraph, what do many universities now offer?
options: Free housing for all new students
Short courses that teach practical digital skills to adults
Lessons only for children under ten

questions.text: What can be inferred about workers who learn new digital skills?
options: They may be better prepared for changes in the job market.
They will certainly never need to change jobs.

questions.text: Why do experts advise young people to stay flexible?
options: Because the jobs they train for may change before they start working.
Because flexible workers always earn more money.
Because technology will stop developing in the future.
Because short courses are the only option available.

vocabulary.definition: to a great or sudden extent
tasks done regularly as a normal part of work
able to change or adapt easily to new situations
teaching workers new skills so they can do a different job

paragraph_translations: Багато експертів вважають, що ринок праці суттєво зміниться протягом наступних двадцяти років. Рутинні завдання в офісах і на заводах дедалі частіше виконують машини. Внаслідок цього працівникам доведеться розвивати навички, які технології не можуть легко замінити, наприклад креативність, комунікацію та критичне мислення. Одні люди бачать у цьому загрозу, а інші — можливість.

Освіта також адаптується до цих змін. Багато університетів зараз пропонують короткі курси, які навчають практичних цифрових навичок дорослих, що хочуть змінити кар'єру. Роботодавці також інвестують у програми перепідготовки своїх працівників. Експерти часто радять молодим людям залишатися гнучкими, адже робота, до якої вони готуються сьогодні, може виглядати зовсім інакше, коли вони нарешті вийдуть на ринок праці.
